[Source: Yogasutra.janvier. 2020.pdf, éd. 2021.pdf | Section: Yoga-Sūtra II.1 (Sādhanapāda) — Tapaḥsvādhyāyeśvarapraṇidhānāni kriyāyogaḥ | Pages 383-391]

itāḥ / te'pi mām eva Kaunteya yajanty avidhipūrvakam // ity
ādivākyebhya iti /
Nanv atra vākye viṣṇvākhyadevatāviśeṣasyaivetaradevatāyajanena yajanaṃ proktaṃ na paramātmana
iti cet ? Na ; paraṃ hi brahma kathitaṃ yogayuktena tanmayā // ity anugītāvākyataḥ śrīkṛṣṇasya
bhagavadgītāyāṃ paramātmopadeśasyaiva lābhād iti / Yady apīśvarasya bhogo nityaḥ tathāpi
sisṛkṣādyutpattivat tadutpattir gauṇī, yajñādisahakāreṇaiva phaladātṛtayeśvaraprīter abhivyakteḥ /
Nanv īśvarapraṇidhānam atra pūrvapādoktabhāvanārūpam eva kathaṃ na bhavati ? Tatrāha sa hi
kriyāyoga iti / Sa hi sa eva phalasaṃnyāsaḥ karmārpaṇaṃ ca kriyāyogo bhavati, karmaśeṣatvāt tajjapas
tadarthabhāvanam iti pūrvokta�
